description.value: Municipal campground on the Nechako River inside Vanderhoof's Riverside Park, with flush toilets, showers, and water and electric hookups at every site; a pleasant town-edge stop with a 10-minute walk to services, operating May through early October.

address.value: 3100 Burrard Ave, Vanderhoof, BC V0J 0A8, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at vanderhoof.ca/visit/camping/ directly describes Riverside Park Campground with rich amenity detail: 38 sites with water and electricity, bathrooms and showers for all campers, free Wi-Fi at the office, a covered picnic area, and downtown Vanderhoof within a 10-minute walk. OSM tag fee=yes is consistent with the paid reservation system described on the website. No campground-specific phone number appears on the website; the only phone shown (250-567-0567) belongs to the Mayor's office line on the municipal contact page.
concerns: No campground-specific phone number found on the website; OSM record also lacks a phone field.
Address field is empty in OSM; the municipal office address (160 Connaught Street, Vanderhoof, BC V0J 3A0) is not the campground's own address and was not used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-documented, municipally operated campground on a central BC touring corridor with confirmed water, electricity, showers, and walkable town access — a strong fit for the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: 38 sites with water and electricity, bathrooms and showers for all campers
